query: UPDATE device_node_keys k SET revoked_at = now() FROM paired_devices d WHERE d.id = k.paired_device_id AND k.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.last_seen_at IS NULL AND d.paired_at < now() - make_interval(mins => $1) AND d.app_variant IN ('Desktop-Workstation', 'Desktop-Display')
